service.description: getDownloads (DownloadList): the download grants the guest's order link (its SalesOrder capability with the Download scope: its one order) or the signed-in verified buyer (the self relationship: their own in this store) reaches, each with its product, order, file, version, size, dates and whether it can be downloaded now; never a location. Refuses a visitor with neither (SIGN_IN_REQUIRED) and another store's or another order's link (NOT_AVAILABLE).

issueDownload (DownloadAction): a capability of ten minutes (SalesOrder, Download, the grant's order) for one grant the caller reaches that is in effect and fulfilled; the frontend streams the file with it at once (getShopDownload). Rate limited by requester; a revoked, expired or another's grant is NOT_AVAILABLE.

getShopDownload: the download capability and the grant checked again (so a revoked grant or an expired capability reaches nothing, whatever a cache kept), the use counted, and the file's location for the transport to stream (it stays on the server) with its name, type and size, and the byte range asked (range: bytes=start-end).

The ShopOrderApprovedFulfillDigital SECA and the job: an approved Shop order's plain digital lines (StoreItemFulfillment, each step in a transaction of its own and resumable by its marker): the payment captured, the lines invoiced (create#FulfillmentInvoice), the invoice finalized (its receipt) and paid, the part checked complete, the download grants, then the download-ready notice. Any other order is left as it is.

The fulfill_StoreItems job: the Shop orders whose digital lines are not done and are due a try, and (Shop P8, impl-shop F96) the approved Shop orders completed in the last days with a line Shop fulfills and no fulfillment row (the approval SECA never ran), and (Shop P9, impl-shop F126) the renewal orders made in those days with no row, each on its own; one that fails is named and the rest go on.
One fulfillment step of an order in its own transaction (called by fulfill#ShopOrder).

The delivery ledger's source build of the download-ready notice (MessageDeliverySource MdsrcShopDownloads): the order's files and where to download them, made fresh for each attempt (a guest's link with a new SalesOrder capability, OrderView and Download, its token only in the message), or suppress when nothing is left to download.

The PaymentRefundedReconcileAccess and ReturnSettledReconcileAccess SECAs (and Accounting's chargeback intake, later): ends the download grants a refund, a return's settlement or a chargeback leaves unpaid: a settled return's digital lines (returnId), a named line, a cancelled line, and every digital line of a Shop order whose payment, less its refunds, no longer covers them (paymentId). Other access is not touched.
Whether OrderApprovedSendEmail skips an order: a Shop order whose lines are all plain digital (its payment's approval is its approval; the receipt and the download notice follow; design-shop §8.3).
